prog='''def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    n=len(g); anchors={}
    for i,row in enumerate(g):
        for j,c in enumerate(row):
            if c not in (0,5): anchors[(2*i//n, 2*j//n)]=c
    sub=[(i,j) for i in range(n) for j in range(n) if g[i][j]==5]
    r0=min(i for i,j in sub); r1=max(i for i,j in sub)
    c0=min(j for i,j in sub); c1=max(j for i,j in sub)
    mr=(r0+r1+1)/2; mc=(c0+c1+1)/2
    for i in range(r0+1,r1):
        for j in range(c0+1,c1):
            q=(0 if i<mr else 1, 0 if j<mc else 1)
            g[i][j]=anchors.get(q, anchors[(1-q[0],1-q[1])])
    return g
'''
